en: Black‑and‑white view of a European city street intersection lined with late‑19th‑century stone townhouses and shops. A wide, almost empty street with visible tram tracks runs through the middle. There are several pedestrians, a cyclist in the foreground, and signage painted on building facades. Text on the buildings appears in German, and one corner building has signs advertising cigarettes and tobacco. The scene has an early 20th‑century atmosphere.
